assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE landscape editorial photograph illustration for an INAYA UAE domestic-worker guide titled 'UAE domestic-worker rights and employer duties'. A respectful private consultation at a sunlit contemporary UAE home: an adult woman household employer in modest navy clothing and an adult domestic worker in a neat pink polo sit at equal height on opposite sides of a small round table, reviewing a plain agreement folder and a simple blank weekly planner together. The worker retains her own closed personal-document wallet in her hand. Warm natural light, realistic skin and hands, refined navy/pink/ivory palette, candid balanced composition, eye-level medium-wide framing, both faces and all key props fully inside the frame. Distinct rights-and-responsibilities discussion, not a recruitment counter or a government office. Landscape about 16:10, suitable for a high-quality blog cover and small thumbnail. No text, no labels, no readable personal data, no logos, no seals, no uniforms implying government affiliation, no watermark. Fictional people; illustrative scene rather than a claim to portray actual INAYA staff or clients.

Her hand uses a pencil to note questions on a blank checklist, not a fake endorsement. Natural daylight, realistic hands and textures, refined navy, ivory and muted pink accents. Both are engaged equals, relaxed professional expressions, realistic human hands, natural candid medium-wide photography.
